subtopic: Binary Search and Monotonic Search Spaces
question_text: When searching for a target in a sorted array that has been rotated at an unknown pivot with distinct elements, what condition determines whether the left half [left...mid] is normally ordered?
answer_explanation: Because all elements are distinct and the array was sorted prior to rotation, if `nums[left] <= nums[mid]`, the inflection pivot cannot lie in the range `[left, mid]`. Thus the left half is guaranteed monotonically increasing.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: Because all elements are distinct and the array was sorted prior to rotation, if `nums[left] <= nums[mid]`, the inflection pivot cannot lie in the range `[left, mid]`. Thus the left half is guaranteed monotonically increasing.
